name: RNA binding motif protein X-linked

function.text: RBMX encodes RNA-binding motif protein, X chromosome [Cleaved into: RNA-binding motif protein, X chromosome, N-terminally processed]. Annotated molecular activities include chromatin binding and mRNA binding. It participates in mRNA splicing, via spliceosome and transcription by RNA polymerase II.
